text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, ondansetron hydrochloride is not on the FDA drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 339 units at 15.5 per day for 22 days on hand. Corvale General holds 399 units at 17.5 per day for 23 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 46 units at 1.6 per day for 29 days on hand. Detailed stock shows Corvale East has 174 units of 4MG TAB (21 days) and 165 units of 4MG TAB (23 days). Corvale General has 132.94 units (15.5 days) and 266.26 units (29.9 days). Corvale Lakeside has 46 units of 4 mg/1 (28.6 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA records show ondansetron hydrochloride is not listed as in shortage as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory across all three sites provides 22 to 29 days of supply. No FDA shortage listing exists. Alternative suppliers are available but none disclose manufacturing plant locations on their labels.

Recommended actions:
1. Continue standard purchasing from current contracted wholesalers. Buyer approves.
2. Evaluate the five ranked alternative suppliers for price and lead time if current contracts fail. Buyer approves; P&T committee approves formulary addition if new NDCs require it.
3. Monitor FDA shortage list weekly for status changes. Buyer approves.

Not recommended: Do not initiate emergency purchases or allocation protocols at this time.
